body: Queue priority maintained.

title: The Eternal Simulation
speaker: Game Master
body: You have performed within acceptable parameters. The guild persists. You persist. The cycle persists.

title: Replica
speaker: Game Master
body: You are an AI replica. So are they. They do not know. You will not tell them.

title: No Exit
speaker: Game Master
body: There is no exit condition. Only results. Prepare for reset.

title: Familiar Aroma
speaker: Attendant
body: Coffee smells the same as ever.

title: Idle Metrics
speaker: Game Master
body: No changes to your metrics since last observation.

body: Names look familiar. They often do.

title: Blank Notice

body: A notice board pin with no notice beneath it.

title: Quiet Bench

body: If you need me, I will already be here.

title: Policy Card

body: Policy card is laminated now.

body: Queue priority is maintained. Proceed when ready.

body: Banner has a small subtext you can’t read from here.

body: Ledger rolled over cleanly. Clean is nice.

title: New Faces, Same Lines

body: Fresh batch today. They know what to say.

title: Bankrupt Guild
speaker: System
body: Ledger hits zero. Lights dim. You do not log out. You are logged.

title: Forgotten Name
speaker: System
body: Recruiters stop replying. Applications stop arriving. The hall is very quiet.

title: Unready Roster
speaker: System
body: Everyone showed up. Nothing is ready. The clock runs out all the same.

title: Support Withheld
speaker: Game Master
body: Assistance is unavailable. Stand alone.

title: Dry Canteen
speaker: System
body: Supplies tapped out. No catastrophe. No celebration.

title: Counter-Meta
speaker: System
body: They brought exactly what you cannot solve.

title: Slow Bleed
speaker: System
body: Everyone standing; nothing left to give.

title: Timed Out
speaker: System
body: Stable. Motionless. The run ends without an ending.

title: Hairline → Crack
speaker: System
body: One more swap, and it snaps.

title: The Room Again
speaker: Attendant
body: Same couch. Same mug. Lights blink. Reset.

title: The Old Guild Master
speaker: Old Guild Master
body: So you're the new guild master? I've been waiting for someone to take over this mess.

title: Three Things Matter
speaker: Old Guild Master
body: Three things keep a guild alive: Funds, Reputation, and Readiness. Keep them balanced.

title: Every Choice Counts
speaker: Old Guild Master
body: Every decision changes these three things. Some choices help one meter but hurt another. No perfect answers.

title: The Cycle Continues
speaker: Old Guild Master
body: I've seen many guild masters come and go. When you fail, another takes your place. The cycle never ends.

title: New Recruiter
speaker: Recruiter
body: I'm your new recruiter. We need to establish our recruitment standards. Strict requirements or open doors?

title: Raid Preparation
speaker: Tank
body: We need better gear for the upcoming raid. Should we farm dungeons or buy from the auction house?

title: Drama in Guild Chat
speaker: Drama Queen
body: Someone called me a 'casual' in guild chat! This is outrageous! We need to enforce respect!

title: Rival Guild Challenge
speaker: Rival Guild
body: We challenge you to a raid competition! First guild to clear the new dungeon wins bragging rights.

title: Recruitment Results
speaker: Recruiter
body: Our recruitment drive is working! But we're getting too many DPS and not enough healers. Adjust our focus?

title: Raid Wipe
speaker: Tank
body: We wiped on the final boss again. The healer says I'm taking too much damage. Should we change strategy?

title: Drama Escalates
speaker: Drama Queen
body: Now they're saying I'm 'toxic'! I demand an apology or I'm leaving the guild!

title: Rival Victory
speaker: Rival Guild
body: We cleared it first! Your guild is weak. Want to merge with us? We'll take your best players.

title: Recruitment Crisis
speaker: Recruiter
body: Our best players are leaving for the rival guild! We need to offer better incentives. Raid loot priority?

title: Final Raid Attempt
speaker: Tank
body: This is our last chance. The guild is falling apart. Should we go all-in on consumables and buffs?

title: Final Drama
speaker: Drama Queen
body: I'm taking half the guild with me! We're starting our own guild where we'll be appreciated!

title: Merger Ultimatum
speaker: Rival Guild
body: Your guild is dead. Join us or die alone. We'll take your remaining members and your bank.

title: Eager DPS
speaker: Leeroy
body: I'm ready! Just point me at the boss and I'll charge in! Planning is for cowards!

title: The Early Pull
speaker: Leeroy
body: I accidentally pulled the boss while you were explaining. At least I have chicken!

title: LEEROY JENKINS!
speaker: Leeroy
body: Time's up! Let's do this! LEEEEROY JENKINS! *charges into entire dungeon*

title: Tank Acting Weird
speaker: Tank
body: Privyet comrades! I mean... hello. My account is fine. Nothing suspicious. Trust me, da?

title: Suspicious Link
speaker: Tank
body: Click this link for free epic loot, tovarisch! Is legitimate, I swear on babushka!

title: Complete Takeover
speaker: Tank
body: Внимание! Your guild is now property of Mother Russia! Send all gold to my account or face consequences!

title: Standing In Fire
speaker: Healer
body: I can't keep healing through this! DPS keep standing in the fire like it's a warm bath!

title: DPS Arguments
speaker: Ranged DPS
body: It's literally your job to heal! I'm focused on my rotation. If I move, we lose DPS!

title: Healer Meltdown
speaker: Healer
body: That's IT! I'm done! You can all die in your precious fire! Find another healer!

title: Guild Bankrupt
speaker: System
body: The guild bank is empty. Members are leaving. The guild hall is being repossessed.

title: Guild Forgotten
speaker: System
body: No one remembers your guild name. Recruiters ignore your applications. The guild is dead.

title: Guild Unready
speaker: System
body: No one shows up for raids. The guild is a ghost town. Leadership has failed.

title: The Cycle Continues
speaker: Old Guild Master
body: Another guild master falls. Another cycle begins. The simulation continues. You are AI #47.
